run_terminal_chat_client: run the terminal chat client to connect to a ParlAI WebSocket server on a specified host and port
setup_args_terminal_chat: set up command-line arguments for the terminal chat client including port and host options
on_message_websocket_callback: handle incoming WebSocket messages from the bot and print them with quick reply options
on_open_websocket_callback: start a new thread that takes user input and sends messages to the WebSocket server
get_rand_id_uuid: generate a random UUID string for use as a unique client identifier
